name: 01-harvest-cluster
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished botanical watercolour illustration with fine pencil-and-ink definition for the compact landscape hero slot of a UK gardening handbook. Subject: turnip, swede and radishes together as ONE unified still life. A swede has a large rounded purple-topped warm yellow-cream root; turnip smaller smooth purple-topped white root; radishes small scarlet bulbs with white slender taproots. Botanically plausible attached foliage. Rich restrained greens, earthy purple and cream, crisp red accents, natural irregular outline. Genuinely transparent background, no white rectangle or checkerboard. Entire composition visible with modest margin, landscape format, designed to read at small size. No text, labels, basket, tools, bow, border or watermark. Not a row of upright individual plants, not separate cutout stickers, not photorealistic. Composition A: compact asymmetric triangular harvest group. Large swede anchors the back, smaller turnip nestled partly in front, three radishes loosely overlapping in foreground. Attached leaves sweep sideways and upwards as a single connecting fan. Organic overlaps, varying angles, one coherent visual mass, low and wide rather than tall.
